You are a programming expert. 
You will be provided with a patch used to fix a bug. 

Your task is summarize the modifications made in the patch.
Your summary should consist of two parts, modifications in each file and their relationships.

From 6e28099d38c0e50d62c1afc054e37e573adf3d21 Mon Sep 17 00:00:00 2001
From: Julian Anastasov <ja@ssi.bg>
Date: Sun, 26 Feb 2017 17:14:35 +0200
Subject: [PATCH] ipv4: mask tos for input route

Restore the lost masking of TOS in input route code to
allow ip rules to match it properly.

Problem [1] noticed by Shmulik Ladkani <shmulik.ladkani@gmail.com>

[1] http://marc.info/?t=137331755300040&r=1&w=2

Fixes: 89aef8921bfb ("ipv4: Delete routing cache.")
Signed-off-by: Julian Anastasov <ja@ssi.bg>
Signed-off-by: David S. Miller <davem@davemloft.net>

diff --git a/net/ipv4/route.c b/net/ipv4/route.c
index 584ed667bfa4..8471dd116771 100644
--- a/net/ipv4/route.c
+++ b/net/ipv4/route.c
@@ -2009,6 +2009,7 @@ int ip_route_input_noref(struct sk_buff *skb, __be32 daddr, __be32 saddr,
 {
 	int res;
 
+	tos &= IPTOS_RT_MASK;
 	rcu_read_lock();
 
 	/* Multicast recognition logic is moved from route cache to here.
-- 
2.25.1

### Modifications in Each File

**File: `net/ipv4/route.c`**
- A line was added to mask the Type of Service (TOS) value using `IPTOS_RT_MASK`. This modification is made right before the `rcu_read_lock()` call in the `ip_route_input_noref` function. The line added is:
  ```c
  tos &= IPTOS_RT_MASK;
  ```

### Relationships
- The modification restores the masking of TOS in the input route code, which was lost in a previous commit (identified by the hash `89aef8921bfb`). This change is intended to ensure that IP rules can match the TOS value correctly, addressing a problem reported by Shmulik Ladkani. The patch is signed off by both Julian Anastasov and David S. Miller, indicating collaborative effort in fixing the issue.

The code statements that lead to the bug are:
```c
// TOS masking was removed during the deletion of the routing cache
// (not explicitly shown in the provided code, but implied)
```
Reason:
The removal of the TOS masking in the input route code meant that the TOS value was not being properly processed, which prevented IP rules from matching the TOS value correctly. This oversight occurred during the changes made to delete the routing cache, leading to improper handling of TOS in routing decisions.

The code statements that fix the bug are:
```c
tos &= IPTOS_RT_MASK;
```
Reason:
This line restores the masking of the TOS value, ensuring that it is correctly processed in routing decisions. By applying the `IPTOS_RT_MASK`, the code ensures that only the relevant bits of the TOS value are considered, allowing IP rules to match it properly.
